name: Speech & Text Analytics
description: Transcription and classification layer that turns every recorded interaction into analyzable structure: topics, sentiment, emotion, compliance events, and machine-proposed dispositions across voice and text channels.
roleInCenter: Listening layer: converts raw interaction media into labeled, queryable events for QA automation, driver analysis, and risk spotting.

glossary.definition: Speech-to-text rendering of call audio, the base layer for all other analytes
Separation of who spoke when: agent, customer, or third party
Detection of mandated or forbidden phrases in transcripts and audio
Controlled taxonomy of conversation themes used to classify every interaction
Polarity scoring of customer expression; distinct from acoustic emotion detection
Acoustic-model classification of anger, frustration, laughter beyond word-level sentiment
Conversational structure metrics: agent-vs-customer airtime and silence spans
Model-proposed outcome label attached to interactions; feeds wrap audit and QA
Muting or masking PCI/HIPAA segments in audio and transcripts before analysis
Share of flagged interactions that reviewers confirm as true findings

children.name: Compliance Monitoring
children.description: Disclosure presence, forbidden-phrase detection, regulated process drift

children.name: Contact-Driver Discovery
children.description: Volume themes feeding CX improvement backlog

children.name: Churn & Risk Signals
children.description: Cancellation language, competitor mentions, escalation threats

children.name: Disposition Audit
children.description: Verify wrap codes against actual conversation outcome

metrics.name: Transcription Accuracy
metrics.definition: Word error rate inverted; gates all downstream analytes

metrics.name: Topic Classification Coverage
metrics.definition: Share of interactions confidently assigned a primary topic

metrics.name: Auto-Disposition Agreement
metrics.definition: Model label agreement with QA-verified human disposition

metrics.name: Negative Sentiment Share
metrics.definition: Interactions scored negative-negative trend; leading indicator for csat

failureModes.name: Transcript Fidelity Drift
failureModes.signal: Acoustic-heavy accents or crosstalk degrade WER silently; topic confidence falls
failureModes.mitigation: Sample human WER audit per channel; recalibration with domain lexicon

failureModes.name: Alert Fatigue
failureModes.signal: Reviewers clear alerts in bulk; precision unmeasured
failureModes.mitigation: Alert precision scorecard; thresholds tuned to reviewer feedback loop

failureModes.name: Sentiment Theater
failureModes.signal: Agent sentiment scores improve while customer measures worsen
failureModes.mitigation: Score customer side only for CX; ban agent-sentiment from QA scores by default

failureModes.name: Redaction Gaps
failureModes.signal: QA finds unredacted PCI in evaluation samples
failureModes.mitigation: Redaction verification as auto-QA artifact before analyst access

exchanges: Interaction records with queue and agent metadata
Unsolicited verbatims mined as VOC listening post
Driver topics without good answers become content backlog
